preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nodes n is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges) for n, edges in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [[tuple(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n - 1)] for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(permutation) == n for n, permutation in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, output.split())) for output in stdout.split('\n')[:-1]]))
postconditions.description: Each output is a permutation of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation) for n, permutation in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, output.split())) for output in stdout.split('\n')[:-1]]))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(permutation)) == n for n, permutation in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)], [list(map(int, output.split())) for output in stdout.split('\n')[:-1]]))
postconditions.description: Each permutation contains each integer from 1 to n exactly once.
